searchText: This is still in Draft, is that intentional? Oh, it is probably to prevent it from auto-merging eh? I wasnt sure it was fixed. It may not be. And you know didn't wanted to slip under the radar again 😅 btw I see the final state was merged for 3541, I wanted to slightly adjust the title given so many were confused, if you'll argue against that change due to final, I'll not push a PR, so asking you <@!301186049323958275> here first? 🙂 I'm fine with non-normative changes to final EIPs, especially ones that help clarify things. I have made similar changes to stuff like EIP-155 back in the day (after it was final).
